purpose: Prevent stale schedule/canonical rollback after operator migration to the new MAIN while supporting SAME MAIN completion-relative continuation.
stale_wake_definition: A wake whose occurrence belongs to an older schedule generation and conflicts with the newest verified durable/live continuation.

predictive_prearm.rule: A wake matching the newest declared predictive_due_at is not stale merely because the predecessor is still fresh. It is a predictive-overlap observation and must follow handoff-recovery PREDICTIVE_PREARM_OVERLAP semantics.
predictive_prearm.schedule_rule: Preserve the newest verified predictive schedule; do not restore the superseded provisional due.
predictive_prearm.takeover_rule: Advance authority only after a fresh durable re-read proves committed close, explicit nonconflicting transfer, or applicable stale-owner recovery.

compatibility_note: The prior custom-recurring and exact one-shot canaries are historical. The operator-created current MAIN uses its recurring hourly category and self-shifts DTSTART to exact END+60. Retired predecessor canonical rollback is forbidden.
